title: Simplifying & ordering radicals根式化简与比较大小

quiz.q: Write 162​ in simplest form.把 162​ 化成最简根式。
opts: 318​
812​
281​
92​
quiz.hint: 162=2⋅81, and 81=92.162=2⋅81，81=92。
quiz.why: Correct: 81⋅2​=92​.正确：81⋅2​=92​。
whys: Used the square 9, not the largest square 81; 18​ still simplifies.用了平方数 9 而不是最大的 81；18​ 还能再化简。
Took 81 out without taking its square root: 81​=9.把 81 提出来却没开方：81​=9。
Put the non-square factor outside; the square factor is the one that comes out.把非平方因数放到外面了；能提出去的是平方因数。
Correct: 81⋅2​=92​.正确：81⋅2​=92​。

quiz.q: Which is the greatest?哪个最大？
opts: 53​
45​
219​

quiz.hint: Move every coefficient inside by squaring it.把每个系数平方后乘进根号。
quiz.why: Correct: as entire radicals they are 75​,80​,76​,72​.正确：化成整根式分别是 75​,80​,76​,72​。
whys: Picked the largest outside number; 53​=75​ is not the biggest.只看外面的系数最大；53​=75​ 并不是最大。
Correct: as entire radicals they are 75​,80​,76​,72​.正确：化成整根式分别是 75​,80​,76​,72​。
Picked the largest number under the root and ignored the small outside 2: 219​=76​.只看根号里的数最大，忽略了外面的 2 很小：219​=76​。
Simplified to 62​ and compared only the coefficient 6; compare 72​ instead.化成 62​ 后只比系数 6；应比较 72​。

quiz.q: A square patio has area 288 m2. An electrician has a 34 m cable and wants to run it along two adjacent sides of the patio. Is the cable long enough? Decide without a calculator and justify your answer; then say how much cable is left over, to the nearest centimetre.一个正方形露台面积为 288 m2。电工有一根 34 m 的电缆，要沿露台相邻的两条边铺设。电缆够长吗？不用计算器作出判断并说明理由；再算出剩余电缆长度，精确到厘米。
quiz.hint: Side =288​. Compare 242​ and 34 by squaring both.边长 =288​。把 242​ 与 34 各自平方来比较。
quiz.ans: Yes: two sides are 242​ m <34 m, leaving about 0.06 m (6 cm).够：两条边共 242​ m <34 m，剩余约 0.06 m（6 cm）。
quiz.why: 288​=144⋅2​=122​, so two sides need 242​ m.288​=144⋅2​=122​，两条边共需 242​ m。
